 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR
Issue notice to opposite party no. 2 by both modes - under registered cover with A/D as well as talbana etc. for which requisite etc. must be filed within one week.
2. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is paying regular maintenance to the opposite party no. 2 but his passport has been deposited as a condition of bail.

It has further been submitted that petitioner has to travel foreign country in connection with his research so he prays that in the interest of justice, the court below be directed to return the said passport.

It has further been submitted that case under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code should Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.52680 of 2023(2) dt.16-08-2023 not become impediment in the studies of the present petitioner.
3. I have heard submissions of the parties.
